**Resolution of the discrepancy:** For BMP10, UniProt's JSON `sequence.length` (530) and `sequence.molWeight` (60,059 Da) do **not** match the actual sequence string (424 aa, md5 verified against the entry's own `md5` field). The authoritative flat-file record (`ID BMP10_HUMAN Reviewed; 424 AA` / `SQ SEQUENCE 424 AA; 48047 MW`) and an independent Biopython calculation both give **424 aa / 48.047 kDa**. I therefore use 48.047 kDa for BMP10. FKTN was internally consistent across all sources (461 aa / 53.724 kDa).

| Protein | UniProt | Length (canonical) | Mass (kDa) |
|---|---|---|---|
| BMP10 | O95393 | 424 aa | 48.047 |
| FKTN | O75072 | 461 aa | 53.724 |

FKTN is heavier by ~5.68 kDa.
